text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the appearance of your longstanding pruritic rash on your palms, specifically noting any scaling, vesicles, or thickening. Additionally, have you noticed any skin changes on the soles of your feet, such as hyperkeratosis or discoloration?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease)

The combination of a long-standing pruritic rash, sensory loss (numbness/tingling) on the palms, and your occupation on a rice farm with livestock contact is highly concerning for leprosy. I need to know if you have noticed any loss of sensation on your face or if you have any deformities or muscle weakness in your hands.
